anglia-ruskin-university-college-aruc.name: Anglia Ruskin University College (ARUC)
anglia-ruskin-university-college-aruc.about: Anglia Ruskin University's story begins in 1858 when the art critic, patron, and philanthropist John Ruskin opened the Cambridge Art School. Cambridge is internationally renowned as a centre of learning. ARU has been in Cambridge since 1858, when the Cambridge School of Art first opened its doors. The friendly, bustling campus is a five minute walk from the historic city centre with its vibrant cultural and social scene.

aston-university-oncampus-centre.name: Aston University ONCAMPUS Centre
aston-university-oncampus-centre.about:
ONCAMPUS Aston is based on the campus of Aston University located in the city of Birmingham. As a top 30 UK university, Aston was the pioneer of the placement year and is renowned for its focus on employability and entrepreneurship.
Aston has been named as University of the Year 2020 (The Guardian) and awarded Outstanding Entrepreneurial University 2020 (Times Higher Education). Aston Business School has also been ranked in the top 100 European Business Schools by the Financial Times in 2020.

asu-london-kaplan.name: ASU London (Kaplan)
asu-london-kaplan.about:
ASU London, offers in-demand degrees in Business, Computing and Engineering, all powered by innovation, technology and AI, and taught through project-based learning.
Globally focused, socially aware and from diverse backgrounds, the engineers of the future will work together to solve problems and improve lives. ASU London has been created to educate and inspire these engineers. ASU London offers a project-based approach to learning.

bangor-university-international-college-.name: Bangor University International College (BUIC)
bangor-university-international-college-.about: Bangor University International College (BUIC) is a specialist Embedded College offering Incorporated Programmes, where international students can begin their studies at Bangor University. BUIC delivers the first stages of the International Incorporated Bachelors Degree, International Year One, and the International Incorporated Masters.

birkbeck-university-of-london-oncampus-l.name: Birkbeck, University of London ONCAMPUS London Centre
birkbeck-university-of-london-oncampus-l.about: Nearly 200 years ago, Birkbeck was founded with the goal of providing higher education to working Londoners; today, the university continues to make education accessible to a diverse community of students. Birkbeck is a world-class research and teaching university, internationally recognised for excellence in the Arts, Law, Business, Economics and Informatics, Social Science, History and Philosophy, and Science.

birmingham-city-university-international.name: Birmingham City University International College (BCUIC)
birmingham-city-university-international.about: Birmingham City University International College (BCUIC) offers students an entry point to a wide range undergraduate and postgraduate degrees, many of which include opportunities for work placements. Students receive academic and language training and support that will prepare them for success in their progression degree.

bournemouth-university-international-col.name: Bournemouth University International College
bournemouth-university-international-col.about: Bournemouth University International College offers pathway courses and Pre-Sessional English programmes in partnership with Bournemouth University, and is located on the University campus. The College is the ideal setting for degree preparation. Students will benefit from state-of-the-art facilities and expert teaching, as well as comfortable accommodation attached to the College building as students start their path degree success. Bournemouth University is creative, enterprising and international.

brunel-university-london-pathway-college.name: Brunel University London Pathway College
brunel-university-london-pathway-college.about: Brunel University London Pathway College is designed to meet the needs of students by offering world-class pathway programs leading to undergraduate and postgraduate degrees at Brunel University London. At undergraduate level, this pathway college offers University Foundation and First year University Studies for candidates who do not meet the direct entry criteria or hold high school qualifications that are not recognized.

cardiff-university-international-study-c.name: Cardiff University International Study Centre
cardiff-university-international-study-c.about:
Students can build confidence in their language skills and subject knowledge as they explore all that Cardiff - and Wales - has to offer. To get to Cardiff University, students can choose Cardiff University International Study Centre to help them prepare to start their degree at a prestigious Russell Group university.
The programs are designed in conjunction with Cardiff University.

edinburgh-napier-university-internationa.name: Edinburgh Napier University International College (ENUIC)
edinburgh-napier-university-internationa.about:
Edinburgh Napier University International College (ENUIC) is an embedded oncampus college for international students to start their studies at Edinburgh Napier
University. It is located in the historic, city centre campus of Merchiston, with easy
access to student accommodation.
Pathway programmes at ENUIC prepare students for their chosen future degree
with academic and English language support.

glasgow-international-college.name: Glasgow International College
glasgow-international-college.about: The University of Glasgow is the 4th-oldest university in the English speaking world and it has been shaping the minds of bright and ambitious students for more than 550 years. It is a place where the past meets the present in truly exciting ways and attending the University of Glasgow means becoming a member of an academic community with a long history of teaching and research excellence. Follow the footsteps of alumni who have changed the world, including 7 Nobel laureates and 3 British Prime Ministers.

hertfordshire-international-college-hic.name: Hertfordshire International College (HIC)
hertfordshire-international-college-hic.about:
Hertfordshire International College (HIC) offers students a modern and dynamic educational experience to study at a modern, business-facing University. They are committed to providing educational pathways and support services in an environment that encourages students to achieve excellence in their studies.
By choosing to study with HIC, students will have access to a wide range of courses and an exciting choice of modules - all designed to prepare them for progression to their chosen degree.

international-college-at-robert-gordon-u.name: International College at Robert Gordon University (ICRGU)
international-college-at-robert-gordon-u.about: Robert Gordon University (RGU) delivers a high quality vocational education and relevant curriculum which provides learners with the skills they require to thrive throughout their careers. As a result, the university has a reputation for producing graduates that are highly sought after by employers. Over the last decade RGU has consistently had one of the best records of any UK university for graduate level employment.

international-college-dundee-icd-univers.name: International College Dundee (ICD), University of Dundee
international-college-dundee-icd-univers.about: International College Dundee offers students an alternative way to begin their undergraduate or postgraduate studies at the University of Dundee. Students will learn core subject knowledge while being supported in the development of academic English and university level study skills. With experienced teachers and small class sizes, students will receive first-class teaching as well as the individual guidance needed to adjust to their new life as a UK university student.

international-college-portsmouth-icp.name: International College Portsmouth (ICP)
international-college-portsmouth-icp.about:
Studying at International College of Portsmouth and then the University of Portsmouth is going to be one of the most exciting times of a student's life. A degree from the University of Portsmouth will offer students the best learning experience and industry exposure. Students can choose from a range of pathway programs designed to prepare them for the next step in their studies.
ICP is an Associate College of the University of Portsmouth founded in 2009.

kaplan-international-college-london-univ.name: Kaplan International College London: University of Birmingham
kaplan-international-college-london-univ.about: Students can build their futures by studying in the UK with a pathway course at Kaplan International College (KIC) London. Situated in the world's top academic city (QS Best Student Cities 2019), KIC London is one of the most-respected international colleges in London. The College offers a wide selection of preparatory courses for students looking to pursue a university degree in the UK.

kaplan-international-college-london-univ.name: Kaplan International College London: University of Bristol
kaplan-international-college-london-univ.about:
Students can build their futures by studying in the UK with a pathway course at Kaplan International College (KIC) London. Situated in the world's top academic city (QS Best Student Cities 2019), the College will prepare students for a university degree and for a successful career.
The University of Bristol is a highly ranked Russell Group university with a fantastic reputation. Students will join a global community of students from more than 150 countries and enjoy life in one of the UK's most exciting cities.

kaplan-international-college-london-univ.name: Kaplan International College London: University of Westminster
kaplan-international-college-london-univ.about:
Students can build their futures by studying in the UK with a pathway course at Kaplan International College (KIC) London. Situated in the world's top academic city (QS Best Student Cities 2019), the College will prepare students for a university degree and for a successful career.
The commercially well-connected University of Westminster is hugely international. Students can study alongside students from nearly 170 countries at the school.

kaplan-international-college-london-univ.name: Kaplan International College London: University of York
kaplan-international-college-london-univ.about: At Kaplan International College (KIC) London - University of York students can build their future by studying in the UK, with a pathway course. Situated in the world’s top academic city (QS Best Student Cities 2019), the College will prepare students for a university degree, and for a successful career. Students are able to study at one of the most respected international colleges in London, and progress to their chosen degree at the University of York.

Its globally renowned faculties, focus on sustainability, and beautiful campus are enjoyed by over 10,000 students from more than 120 countries. Keele University offers a wide variety of programs to provide students with an individualized learning experience, and they can contribute to the university’s groundbreaking research in global health, sustainability, and sociology.

By studying in an immersive environment, students can improve their English language abilities whilst gaining the academic experience they need for university. The International Study Centre provides the knowledge and skills needed for international study at Kingston University, London.

london-metropolitan-university-with-eca.name: London Metropolitan University with ECA
london-metropolitan-university-with-eca.about: Based in one of the world's most exciting capital cities, London Metropolitan University is home to a diverse community of inspiring and determined learners, teachers and innovative thinkers. They offer a wide range of courses, from undergraduate and postgraduate degrees to short courses and professional qualifications. London Metropolitan University takes pride in helping students reach their goals and succeed in their careers.

london-south-bank-university-oncampus-ce.name: London South Bank University ONCAMPUS Centre
london-south-bank-university-oncampus-ce.about:
ONCAMPUS London South Bank is based on the campus of London South Bank University (LSBU), one of the leading modern universities in the UK. Students who study at ONCAMPUS London South Bank are guaranteed progression to London South Bank University on successful completion of their Foundation programme.
At LSBU they are committed to giving our students the very best opportunities and education. This means they give their students not only the qualifications but the skills and knowledge for their careers.

loughborough-university-oncampus-centre.name: Loughborough University ONCAMPUS Centre
loughborough-university-oncampus-centre.about: ONCAMPUS Loughborough is located on the campus of one of the most ambitious and top performing universities in the UK - Loughborough University. On successful completion of the foundation programme, students will have the opportunity for progression to some of the most highly-ranked and innovative degrees at this UK's top university.

manchester-metropolitan-university-inter.name: Manchester Metropolitan University International College
manchester-metropolitan-university-inter.about: Manchester Metropolitan University International College is a part of Manchester Metropolitan University, providing pathway courses to help international students get ready to study undergraduate and masters degrees. The curriculum complements the University’s teaching and commitment to high-quality learning and students can choose from courses at Foundation, International Year One or Pre-Masters levels.

northumbria-university-pathway-college.name: Northumbria University Pathway College
northumbria-university-pathway-college.about: Northumbria University Pathway College - Newcastle is to deliver Pathway programmes at the City Campus in Newcastle. Pathway programmes are delivered in Newcastle and enable International students to develop their English language and academic skills on programmes that are specifically tailored to their chosen progression subject area, with teaching delivered at the main university campus.

nottingham-trent-international-college.name: Nottingham Trent International College
nottingham-trent-international-college.about: Nottingham Trent International College (NTIC) offers pathway courses in partnership with Nottingham Trent University (NTU), and is integrated into the University campus. Students can prepare for their future with pathway courses from Nottingham Trent International College. With high-quality teaching, world-class facilities and exceptional support, students will have everything they need to follow their path to success at university and beyond.

royal-holloway-university-of-london-inte.about: Students that do not meet the academic requirements for direct entry to Royal Holloway are able to apply for Foundation, International Year One and Pre-master's programs at the Royal Holloway International Study Centre. A foundation program bridges the gap between a student's high school education and the first year of study at Royal Holloway, as well as providing an opportunity to develop English language skills.

solent-university-pathway-college.about: Solent University Pathway College to deliver a range of programmes for foundation to undergraduate level. The International Foundation Programme pathway programmes are designed to help International students improve their academic and English language skills before undertaking undergraduate degree studies with Solent University.

the-college-swansea-university.name: The College, Swansea University
the-college-swansea-university.about: Located in a dedicated building on the Bay Campus, The College gives students the opportunity to settle into university life and stay on track to obtain their Swansea University degree. When students start their studies with Swansea they have access to all the facilities and services that a direct entry Swansea University student has, including Swansea University’s Global Alumni Network. Students can make valuable connections with alumni across the world who can offer mentoring opportunities and careers advice.

the-university-of-sheffield-internationa.name: The University of Sheffield International College
the-university-of-sheffield-internationa.about:
The University of Sheffield International College gives you the perfect introduction to studying abroad. We teach more than 2,000 students every year, preparing them for the challenges of studying their undergraduate or postgraduate degree at a top-ranking Russell Group University.
For many international students, studying abroad brings some challenges that need a little extra support.

university-of-aberdeen-international-stu.about:
The University of Aberdeen International Study Centre is located at the heart of the historic King’s College Campus. It offers a full range of subject options and pathways, including tailored programs in engineering and medical studies.
The UK’s fifth oldest university, Aberdeen has been offering life-changing learning opportunities for more than 500 years. Today, it adds to this rich heritage with modern facilities and a 21st-century outlook.

university-of-bradford-international-col.name: University of Bradford International College (UBIC)
university-of-bradford-international-col.about:
The University of Bradford International College (UBIC) is an embedded college located in the centre of the University of Bradford in West Yorkshire, England. UBIC offers pathway programmes for international students to prepare them for undergraduate and postgraduate studies in the UK.
The pathway programmes offer students various routes to a degree.

university-of-brighton-international-col.name: University of Brighton International College
university-of-brighton-international-col.about: The University of Brighton International College (UBIC) offers pathway courses in partnership with the University of Brighton for international students who seek additional preparation for university study. Located within the University of Brighton campus, UBIC students have access to the excellent facilities of the University and everything they need to follow their paths to a University of Brighton degree.

university-of-central-lancashire-oncampu.name: University of Central Lancashire ONCAMPUS UK North Centre
university-of-central-lancashire-oncampu.about: From the centre at ONCAMPUS UK North, based on the campus of the University of Central Lancashire (UCLan), students are encouraged to develop the skills required for progression onto degree programmes at the best UK universities. With their partner UCLan, offering guaranteed progression (subject to achieving progression criteria), students can choose to continue onto a degree at UCLan or apply to any other UK university with help and support through the UCAS application process.

university-of-essex-international-colleg.name: University of Essex International College
university-of-essex-international-colleg.about: The University of Essex was founded in the 1960s as an innovative institution to challenge traditional thinking. It is highly ranked in many subjects, giving students the chance to advance their education in a field they love. It offers a beautiful main campus just outside the city of Colchester, which is only 1 hour from London by train. Essex is a hugely international university, with students of 140+ nationalities bringing great diversity of cultures and ideas, creating a truly global campus community.

university-of-greenwich-international-co.about: University of Greenwich International College (UGIC) is an embedded college delivered on the main campus at University of Greenwich, in London. UGIC provides the first stages of the International Incorporated Bachelors and the International Incorporated Masters programs. During the pathway program, students are prepared for university-level studies by learning core subject knowledge while developing their academic English level and study skills.

university-of-huddersfield-international.name: University of Huddersfield International Study Centre
university-of-huddersfield-international.about: The University of Huddersfield International Study Centre is dedicated to preparing international students with the academic and English language skills needed to successfully complete a wide range of undergraduate and postgraduate degree study at the University of Huddersfield. Courses offered here will help students adjust to life in the UK and make sure students are fully equipped to enter their chosen degree as a comfortable and confident student.

university-of-hull-oncampus-centre.name: University of Hull ONCAMPUS Centre
university-of-hull-oncampus-centre.about: ONCAMPUS Hull is based on the campus of the University of Hull, one of the oldest universities in England. Students that study at ONCAMPUS Hull are guaranteed progression to the University of Hull on successful completion of their Foundation programme. When students enrol on their programme of study at ONCAMPUS, they will be assigned a Personal Tutor, who is responsible for ensuring they have adequate academic support during their time at ONCAMPUS.

university-of-kent-international-college.name: University of Kent International College (UKIC)
university-of-kent-international-college.about:
University of Kent International College is an embedded college on the Canterbury campus at University of Kent. It is a specialist
embedded pathway college, where
international students can begin
their studies at University of Kent in
partnership with Oxford International
Education Group.
We prepare you for the future
Whatever your ambitions are, they’re
never too bold for Kent; we’ve helped our
students achieve some amazing things.

university-of-leeds-international-study-.name: University of Leeds International Study Centre
university-of-leeds-international-study-.about:
Leeds International Study Centre works in collaboration with the University of Leeds and Leeds Beckett University to prepare students from outside of the UK for successful degree study. The courses offer students the opportunity to study abroad in the UK, and provide additional support to students who do not meet the entry requirements to apply directly to either university.
Leeds Beckett University, established in 1824, is home to students from 144 countries.

university-of-nottingham-international-c.about: The University of Nottingham International College offers degree preparation courses in partnership with the University of Nottingham, and is situated right by University Park campus. This International College in Nottingham can help students follow their paths to a degree at the prestigious University, and will provide students with a life-changing student experience in an exciting UK city.

university-of-plymouth-international-col.name: University of Plymouth International College (UPIC)
university-of-plymouth-international-col.about: University of Plymouth International College (UPIC) offers international students a broad selection of undergraduate and postgraduate pathway options to prepare themselves for their studies at University of Plymouth. These programs are specially designed for students who don't have the high school leaving grades or level of English required to begin their studies at the university.

university-of-southampton-oncampus-centr.name: University of Southampton ONCAMPUS Centre
university-of-southampton-oncampus-centr.about: The University of Southampton, ranked joint 15th in the UK and 90th in the world, has developed a global reputation for outstanding academic research and teaching. As a founding member of the Russell Group, an organisation of 24 leading UK universities synonymous with quality academic education, Southampton is committed to innovative thinking, pioneering research, and inventive education.

university-of-strathclyde-international-.name: University of Strathclyde International Study Centre
university-of-strathclyde-international-.about: The University of Strathclyde International Study Centre provides specialist degree preparation for international students studying abroad. Once students have successfully completed their preparation programme and met the progression criteria, they can begin their chosen university degree. They aim to give students the best chance of success when they progress to their degree at the University of Strathclyde.

university-of-sunderland-oncampus-centre.name: University of Sunderland ONCAMPUS Centre
university-of-sunderland-oncampus-centre.about:
ONCAMPUS Sunderland is based on the campus of the University of Sunderland, one of the leading modern universities in the UK. Students who study at ONCAMPUS Sunderland are guaranteed progression to the University of Sunderland on successful completion of their Foundation programme.
The University of Sunderland is an innovative, forward-thinking university with high standards of teaching, research and support that sits at the heart of one of the UK’s most up-and-coming cities.

university-of-surrey-international-study.name: University of Surrey International Study Centre
university-of-surrey-international-study.about: At the University of Surrey International Study Centre students can pursue programs for a range of interests from creative arts, to business, sciences and engineering. Each program introduces students to the UK style of teaching while raising students' academic skills, English language level and study skills. The International Foundation Year and the Pre-Masters each offer a choice of three academic routes.

university-of-the-west-of-england-bristo.name: University of the West of England Bristol International College
university-of-the-west-of-england-bristo.about: The University of the West of England (UWE) Bristol’s International College offers pathway courses in partnership with UWE Bristol, and is integrated into the University campus. The College is fully equipped to help students prepare for their university degree. With dedicated and experienced staff and outstanding facilities, students will be supported at every step as they start their path to university.

university-of-york-international-pathway.name: University of York International Pathway College
university-of-york-international-pathway.about: Established in 1963, the University of York is among the best universities in the UK, being ranked top 20 overall top 25 for graduate prospects (Complete University Guide 2023). It offers students a beautiful campus with modern facilities, in one of the UK’s safest and most friendly cities. As a Russell Group university, York is a leader in research, which translates into excellent and relevant teaching for students.

aberystwyth-university.name: Aberystwyth University
aberystwyth-university.about: Aberystwyth University was founded in 1872 in the Welsh seaside town after which it is named. On the west coast of Wales between Cardigan Bay and the Cambrian Mountains, students will become part of a historic, vibrant, friendly and outward-looking community. As the first university in Wales, Aberystwyth’s reputation for research power, teaching excellence, student satisfaction and our incredible location are what set it apart from other universities.

arden-university.name: Arden University
arden-university.about:
Arden University provides access to the skills, knowledge, and opportunities learners need to further their careers and achieve the success they deserve.
As an innovative and applied university, Arden’s cutting-edge digital learning platforms contain all the support students need to succeed. The University was recognised in the latest National Student Survey in 2025 as No 5 in the UK for student satisfaction and has more than 40,000 ambitious students learning with it.

bath-spa-university.name: Bath Spa University
bath-spa-university.about:
Bath Spa University is a UK-based institution renowned for its emphasis on creativity, culture, and enterprise. It offers a diverse range of programs across arts, sciences, education, social sciences, and business, aiming to equip students with the skills and support needed to pursue their passions .
Established in 1852 as the Bath School of Art, the university has a rich heritage in the arts. Notably, artists such as Walter Sickert and Howard Hodgkin have been associated with the institution.
